note: Set A binds the schedule rows more faithfully overall, correctly pairing items 33, 34, 31, 50, 32, 10 and 150/151 with their descriptions and capturing the 4 AWG copper-to-ground and current-sensor connections. Set A does contain two bad entries (an invented 'Cable 24' row and a wrong spec for item 50 read as '3WB, #10'), plus one garbled '3440' misread of 3#4/0. Set B misreads item 20 as 3#10/1#12G instead of 3#12/#12G, mis-binds the 2-1/2" conduit size as a cable diameter, and repeats the '3440' misread twice, while also duplicating the 150A main-breaker claim. Both sets have trivial identifier claims, but A covers more correct facts with fewer substantive errors.
